name: FrameGuard (Experimental)
description: Experimental Practice-only Wave timing assist. Approximate static-world predictor; player-only rewind, NOT universal rollback.

enabled.name: Enable assist (Practice only)
enabled.description: Experimental. Single forward Wave in static levels. No guarantee of survival; not suitable for records.

window.name: Correction window (physics frames)
window.description: 0 disables correction. One frame is one observed PlayerObject physics update, not one rendered frame. Disable TPS/speed/CBF mods for initial tests.

rollback.name: Experimental LOCAL rollback
rollback.description: Player-only checkpoint restore and linear Wave replay. NOT a full game-state rollback. Briefly suppresses collision death while waiting for late input, bounded by the correction window. Static levels + Practice only. Read README_RU.md.
